Every nested value here renders exit 0 under `quarto render` 1.7.33, so the feature
must produce ZERO diagnostics: `execute.echo: fenced` (valid enum member),
`execute.eval: false` (valid boolean), `execute.output: "…"` (OPEN, a MULTI-LINE
DOUBLE-QUOTED scalar — quarto folds both lines into one string; the continuation line
reads `echo: false …` but is INSIDE the quote, so it must NOT be enumerated as a nested
`echo` value and flagged — the adversarial-review CRITICAL FP guard, now render-verified
exit 0), `execute.daemon: 30` (OPEN number), `execute.cache: refresh` (valid enum
member), `format.html.toc: true` / `format.html.number-sections: false` (valid
booleans), `format.html.df-print: kable` (valid enum member), `format.html.theme: cosmo`
(OPEN free string).
